task: Trim whitespace from conversation folder names across all backend write paths and read-side serialization, plus a gated Alembic migration to normalize/merge existing production data.

component_scope.label: XL
component_scope.layers: API DTO, Model/Persistence, Service, Router, DB-Migration

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: None material — implementation matches plan.md task-by-task almost exactly; the only expansion beyond plan was tightening the migration's locking strategy (row-scoped FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED in apply mode only, non-locking read in dry-run) for extra concurrency safety, which was a refinement rather than a clarification gap.

technical_risk.label: XXL
technical_risk.risk_factors: Irreversible data migration (collision-merge deletes losing conversation_folders rows and repoints conversations.folder before deletion); no prior codebase precedent for multi-row merge-by-earliest-date logic; concurrent-write safety required (implemented via per-batch FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED with skip-and-retry semantics, plus a Default-folder-name exclusion to avoid colliding with the app-level forbidden-name guard)
technical_risk.mitigation: Migration is dry-run by default, gated behind EPMCDME_13806_APPLY_FOLDER_MERGE env var; downgrade() is an intentional documented no-op; chunked batching (1000 groups) with row-scoped locking prevents full-table locks; code-review-final.json findings (8) were all fixed and verified resolved in code-review-check.json

key_reasoning.reason: Migration's collision-merge logic (earliest-date-wins, repoint conversations.folder across two tables, delete losing rows) is irreversible once applied and had no exact precedent — implementation went further than plan.md's draft by scoping FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED to only the batch's row ids (not the whole table) and adding skip-and-retry semantics plus a Default-folder exclusion.

Actually touched 5 distinct components: two DTO modules (core/models.py, rest_api/models/conversation.py), the ConversationFolder model, ConversationService, and the router — plus the migration, exactly matching plan.md's 5-write-path + read-side + migration scope with no reduction.

11 files touched (7 modified, 4 new) confirmed via Glob/Read: DTO/model/service/router source changes plus 3 new test files and 1 existing test file extended per component; migration red flag bumps this from L to XL.
